description: This file defines an Android IntentService called QuizReportActionService, which handles the 'Reset Quiz' action by connecting to a GoogleApiClient, retrieving capability information from connected wearable nodes, and sending a reset message to the capable node.

classes.name: QuizReportActionService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that handles resetting the quiz by communicating with paired wearable devices.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles the intent, establishing a connection with GoogleApiClient, retrieving capability info, and triggering a reset message if conditions are met.

methods.name: sendResetMessage
methods.description: Sends a reset message to all connected nodes capable of resetting the quiz.
